summary: Winner profile that generalizes 2025->2026: the fill itself must be with the tape, on a committed book, without fighting the last 15 min. (1) PROFILING (top-vs-bottom $ quartile, stable both years): PRE winners = cvd_conf/conf_PM=1, after a green day, on QUIET overnights (low |cvd_ON|, |cvd_LON|, on_range, |gap|); GOLD winners = fill_delta_conf/delta_div_y=1, premarket tape NOT aligned (pm_sofar_conf=0, contrarian), thicker/supported depth, expanded 20d range. (2) The single strongest separator is fill_delta_conf (fill-bar delta agrees with direction): ~+18pp win rate in BOTH years in every slice. Best frozen 2-feature AND combo: fill_delta_conf==1 & |dep_imb|>=0.154 (2025 q75) -> 2025 50.7%/$+126 (n=69), out-of-sample 2026 42.6%/$+89 (n=54) vs 28.2%/-$14 base; also surviving: gold d15_conf&conf_last15 (+20.5/+12.2pp) and gold d15_conf&d30_ds>=382 (2026 34%/$+160). Combos leaning on 2025 volatility-regime features (patheff, rel_range, gap, thin-depth-delta) died in 2026 via n-collapse or lift-collapse. (3) Quality score (5 components, all 2025-frozen params): monotone-ish; score>=4 gives 34.4%/$+68 (2025, n=125) and 44.9%/$+91 (2026, n=69), gaps +11.4pp/$145 and +20.1pp/$125 vs rest — passes both evidence rules; the >=3 cut does NOT generalize. Loser tail is equally stable: adverse fill delta (pre bottom-quartile fill_delta_ds: 6.6%/18.8% wr), fighting the 15-min tape in gold (9.6% wr 2026), score<=1 (18% both years). Caveat: 2026 gold base decayed to 25.0%/-$89 while pre improved to 30.2%/+$32; the surviving signals hold within both windows.
